rationale: This candidate has the lowest hindcast SMAPE by a wide margin (5.50 versus 10.25, 11.67, and 12.96), and no fold-instability evidence or stated failure condition is established. Its diversified assumption includes recent-level persistence, which fits the documented tight, horizontal, non-periodic post-update equilibrium in doc_7407. That evidence directly weakens the harmonic and phase-recurrence assumptions of the competing candidates. Doc_7396 also establishes that the temporary indexing shock ended before the forecast window and utilization returned to baseline, supporting reversion without carrying the shock forward. The logging evidence does not show that observation changes altered CPU values and therefore does not justify overriding the historical leader.
